docTitle: Bibidia mu Mapa · Bibidia mu Mukanda Umoxi
metaDesc: Landa o ndondo ia Kikutu kia Kale, o muenhu ua Jezú, ni o njila ja Phaulu mu mapa ia kidi — o Bibidia iabhitile mu jididi ja kidi.

s.title: Bibidia mu Mapa
s.verse: “Kuma etu ki tua kaiela misoso iofunhe ni ndunge ja muthu uoso-uoso, kioso ki tua mi tudila o Njimbu ia unéne ni kuiza kua Ngana ietu, Jezú Kristu. Maji etu tuala tu jimbangi, kuma o unéne uê tua di muena-u ni mesuʼetu!” (II Phetele 1:16)
s.purpose: O Bibidia ki kixinganeku kia phulu kana. Muene o disoneku dia athu a enda mu jididi ja kidi, mu mizuua ni majina ma kidi. Landa o njila jenhá mu mapa, mu ndondo ia thembu — tumbula kididi kimoxi, mba fiula ▶ phala kuenda mu kiô sene ku sene.
s.ot_kick: ① Kikutu kia Kale — mu thembu
s.ot_h: Tunde ku dibhangelu katé ku kuvutuka ku Jeluzaleme
s.ot_lead: Ki njila imoxi ngó kana, maji o kuenda kua musoso ua kubhuluka tunde ku dibhangelu: dibhangelu ni kubhua → o menha ma dikota ni Bábhele → o kikanenu (Abalahámi) → o ixi iakanenua → o Kutunda → o dikangu → o kufunga → o utuminu → o kubatuka → o ukuatelu → o kuvutuka.
s.je_kick: ② Kikutu Kiabhe — o muenhu ua Jezú
s.je_h: Tunde ku Belene katé ku Jeluzaleme
s.je_lead: Landa o muenhu ua Jezú kala o Jinjimbu Jiambote ji tanga, mu ndondo — tunde ku kuvualua kuê mu Belene, mu kubatizua kuê ni o sidivisu mu Galiléia, mu Samádia, katé ku dikulusu, o kufukunuka ni o kubandela mu Jeluzaleme.
s.pa_kick: ③ Kikutu Kiabhe — o njila ja Phaulu
s.pa_h: Tunde ku Antiokia katé ku maẋokololo ma jixi — Loma
s.pa_lead: Tunde ku Phentekostesi mu Jeluzaleme, kiebhi o Njimbu Iambote iasuluka ku kanga dia Judeia — mu Ásia Iofele ni Eulopa katé ku muxima ua utuminu. Sola njila imoxi mu jinjila jitanu (dia dianga·iaiadi·iatatu + o luendu ku Loma + ku rima dia kutunda kaleia) anga landa o ima ia Jipoxolo kumoxi ni o jimukanda jasonekua mu njila.
s.foot: Ididila · O jididi ja landa o disoneku dia Bibidia ni o kuijiia kua jididi ja Bibidia (ni majina ma lelu bhu ki tokala). O jimbandu ja kalunga, o jingiji, ni o majiba ja tundu mu ididila ia jeografia iajikuka (Natural Earth), iabhungululua.

eden.name: Edene (Dibhangelu · Kubhua)
eden.note: Mu ngongo iabhangelua «iambote kiavulu», o ituxi iiza anga i batula o ukamba bhu kaẋi ka Nzambi ni o muthu.
events: O dibhangelu mu mizuua isamanu — «iaxile iambote kiavulu»
O muthu uabhangelua mu kifua kia Nzambi
O kubhua, ni o kukatulua ku Edene
O kikanenu kia dianga kia Njimbu Iambote — «o mbutu ia muhatu i kà bula o mutue ua nhoka»

noah.name: Alalate (o Menha ma Dikota)
noah.today: Mulundu Ararate, ku kutunda kua Turkia lelu
noah.note: Nzambi u fundisa o ngongo iezala ni ituxi, maji u lamba o muenhu mu muiji umoxi.
events: O ngongo iezala ni undumbu
O menha ma dikota, ni o ngalaua ia Noé
O kikutu ni o dikuma dia mu kilu — «ki ku kala dingi menha phala kubhukumuna o ngongo»

babel.name: O Dibhata dia Bábhele
babel.note: Ku pholo ia usunga ua kusota o kilu, Nzambi u sanguna o mizui iâ ni o miiji mu ngongo ioso.
events: «Tuzé tutunge mbanza ni dibhata dia kubandalela… tudibhane dijina»
Nzambi u sanguna o dimi diâ
O miiji i sanguka mu ngongo (Sineare — kurima Babilónha)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: O musoso ua kubhuluka ua Bibidia u matekena ni o kikanenu kia muthu umoxi.
events: Nzambi u ixana Abalahámi ku Ur ua akua Kalade
«Ngi ku bhanga muiji ua dikota… o miiji ioso i kà zediuila mu eie»
Mu kuxikana u tunda o ixi iê

haran.name: Halane
haran.note: Mu njila, u tambulula o kikanenu ku mbandu ua ixi iakanenua.
events: O muiji ua Tela u xikama mu Halane
Tela u fua
Abalahámi u tunda phala Kanaane ku mivu 75

shechem.name: Sikeme · Kanaane
shechem.note: Mu ixi iakanenua o muiji uabhangela anga o kikutu ki bhita ku jindandu.
events: Kubhokela mu Kanaane, o jisata dia dianga — «ku mbutu ié ngi bhana o ixi iii»
O kikutu (Dimatekenu 15) · Izaki · Jakobe
O an'a Jakobe akumi-aiadi — o mbutu ia jindandu akumi-aiadi

egypt.name: Ijitu (Gosene)
egypt.note: O muiji ubhua mundu ua dikota — anga kurima mundu ua abhika.
events: Zuze, uasumbisua, ubhua mfumu mu Ijitu
O muiji uoso ua Jakobe u loloka ku Ijitu mukonda dia nzala
O mundu ua Izalaiele u kula anga ubhua ubhika

sinai.name: Mulundu Sinai
sinai.note: O kibhuluku kia dikota kia Kikutu kia Kale — abhika a bhua mundu ua Nzambi.
events: O mahadi akumi ni o mona a panda ua Phaxika
O Kalunga Kakusuka ka batuka anga a bhitila
O Itumu Ikumi, o Kitumu, o tembulu ni o jisata

kadesh.name: Kadesi (o dikangu)
kadesh.note: O kukamba kuxikana ku katula ku muiji o ixi — maji Nzambi u kala kumoxi ni ene.
events: O axidi akumi-aiadi — maji o mundu u bhinga kuxikana
Mivu 38 mu dikangu — o maná, o jingunga ja dikangu ni dia túbhia
Bhu kianga kia Moabe, o malongi ma disukilu ma Mozé (Matendelelu)

jericho.name: Jeliko
jericho.note: Ku disukilu a bhokela anga a funga o ixi iakanenua.
events: O Jodáu ua batuka anga o mundu ua bhitila
O jimbaka ja Jeliko ja bhua
O kufunga kua Kanaane ni o kubatula o ixi

shiloh.name: Xilo (Afundixi)
shiloh.note: Sé sobha, muthu uoso u bhanga ki kiamuiukila — o sobha ua kidi u bhingiua.
events: O tembulu di bhaka mu Xilo
O ngiluluka ia phulu–kifundisu–kubhuluka (Debola, Jideone, Sanasone)
Lute — o kidielela mu izuua ia dixima, mu uana ua Davidi

jerusalem.name: Jeluzaleme · Utuminu Uakutakana
jerusalem.note: O thembu iambote ia Izalaiele — ni o kikanenu kia sobha ua muku.
events: Saúle o sobha ua dianga, kurima Davidi ni Goliata
O kikutu kia Davidi — «o kiandu kié ki kà xala muku» (II Samuuele 7)
Salomáu u tunga o tembulu mu Jeluzaleme

samaria.name: Samádia · Utuminu Uabatuka
samaria.note: O utuminu u batuka anga u fefuka kioso o jipolofeta a dikola.
events: Ku rima dia Salomáu, o kubatuka mu Juda ni Izalaiele
O kulundila iteka kua kuiibhala
Eliia, Izaía, Jelemiia a dikola «vutukenu» — anga a londekesa o Masiia

nineveh.name: Nínive (Asília)
nineveh.note: Ku kubhingesa o malongomenu moso, o utuminu ua kumayuelu u bhua dianga.
events: Nínive, o kasanji ka Asília
O utuminu ua kumayuelu u bhua kua Asília (722 K.K.)
Jona u tumikisua ku Nínive

babylon.name: Babilónha
babylon.note: O usuku ua dixima kuhiana ioso — maji o kikanenu kia kuvutulula ki xala.
events: Jeluzaleme u bhua, o tembulu di túbhia (586 K.K.)
Juda uambatua ku Babilónha
Daniiele ni Izekiiele — kuxikana ni ikimonekenu mu ukuatelu

susa.name: Susa (Pélesia)
susa.note: Né mu muxima ua utuminu ua akua jixi, Nzambi u langa o mundu uê.
events: Pélesia i xina Babilónha
Estere u bhulula o aJudé ku kufua
Nehemiia u samba ku pholo ia sobha anga u tumikisua

return.name: O Kuvutuka ku Jeluzaleme
return.note: A vutuka anga a tunga — maji sobha ki ueza. A kinga o Masiia.
events: Jindenge jitatu ja kuvutuka mu kitumu kia Sílo (Zolobabele 538 · Ejidala 458 · Nehemiia 444)
O tembulu di tungulula anga o jimbaka ja Jeluzaleme ja tungulula
Malakiia — o Kikutu kia Kale ki sukila: «ngi tumikisa o mukunji uami»

bethlehem.name: Belene
bethlehem.note: O Masiia uakanenua ueza ku mbanza ia Davidi — o Diambu dia bhanga xitu.
events: Uavualua mu Belene, o mbanza ia Davidi
O jianju a tangela o afunga o njimbu
O alobhi a jixi eza kubheza

nazareth.name: Nazaleti
nazareth.note: Nzambi u kula kala muthu mu mbanza ia kifua.
events: Uatekulua mu nzo ia salabhixi ua mabhaia
Ku mivu akumi-aiadi, u ibhula ni u tambujila mu tembulu
Kurima a mu xina mu nzo ia kibhanga ia mbanza iê

jordan.name: O Ngiji ia Jodáu
jordan.today: o mbandu ua bhoxi ua Jodáu lelu
jordan.note: O sidivisu uê ua bhonga u matekena — o diulu di mu xikina kala Mona.
events: Uabatizua kua Nzuá
O Nzumbi i loloka kala pumbu — «Iú Mona ami ua kazola»
U xina o kutuata kutatu kua Satanaji mu dikangu

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: Mu dikuma diê dia dianga u londekesa o unène uê.
events: Ungenji mu ukulu
O menha ma bilula vinhu — o dikuma diê dia dianga
O adisíbulu jê a mu xikina

sychar.name: Sikale (Samádia)
sychar.note: O njila ia sidivisu ia dianga — mu Jeluzaleme katé ku Samádia iaxinwa.
events: U zelesa o tembulu mu Jeluzaleme
Ku usuku, Nikodemu — «Uatokala kuvualua dingi»
Menha ma muenhu ku muhatu ua Samádia

capernaum.name: Kapenaú
capernaum.today: ku mbandu ua kalunga ka Galiléia lelu
capernaum.note: O nzo ia sidivisu ia Galiléia — o kixanenu, o malongi, ni o kutata i sanga bhabha.
events: U ixana o alobhi a jimbiji anga u xikama bhabha
O malongi ma ku mulundu — «A di besá o asukami mu nzumbi»
O jisabhu ja Utuminu — ni o kutata kuakola

galilee.name: Kalunga ka Galiléia
galilee.note: Ni o nguzu iê ku thandu dia ngongo u londekesa o kála kuê.
events: «Tululuka, kala kie» — u tulula o kitembu
U disa athu 5.000 ni mbolo jitanu ni jimbiji jiiadi
U enda ku thandu dia menha

caesarea_p.name: Kezaléia ia Filipe
caesarea_p.note: O adisíbulu a kijiia kuma muene o Kristu, anga o njila ia dikulusu i jikuka.
events: O kuxikana kua Phetele — «Eie o Kristu, o Mona a Nzambi ua muenhu»
U londekesa dianga o kufua ni o kufukunuka kuê
U balumuka mu unène ku mulundu

jericho.name: Jeliko
jericho.note: Mu njila ia kubandalela ku Jeluzaleme, u sota o iajimbidila.
events: U jikula o mesu ma Bartimeu o mufofo
U ixana Zakeu o mufutisi
«O Mona a muthu ueza kusota ni kubhulula o iajimbidila»

bethany.name: Betánia
bethany.note: U londekesa o kála kuê ku thandu dia kufua ku dizubhilu dia simana iê ia disukilu.
events: U balumuna Lázalu ku mbila — «Eme o kufukunuka ni o muenhu»
Madiya u mu bhaka maji phala o kuziika
O dikuma diki di kolesa o kudibhonza phala ku mu jibha

jerusalem.name: Jeluzaleme
jerusalem.note: O kifukutilu o Bibidia ioso i londekesa — dikulusu, kufukunuka, kubandela.
events: O kubhokela mu ngenji; u balumuna dingi o jimeza ja tembulu
Ku Kúdia kua Disukilu u sukula o inama ia adisíbulu
U fua ku dikulusu
Ua fukunuka ku kizuua kiatatu, kurima ua bandela

antioch.name: Antiokia
antioch.note: O dingeleja dia kutumikisa mudi o sidivisu ku aJentiu di matekena anga di vutukila.
events: Mu musambu o Nzumbi i sola Balunabe ni Saulu
O dingeleja mudi abheululu a a ixana o dianga «aKristau»
O kididi kia kumatekena o njila ia dianga, iaiadi ni iatatu

seleucia.name: Seleukia
seleucia.note: O poltu ua Antiokia — a enda mu ngalaua ku Xipele.

salamis.name: Salami (Xipele)
salamis.note: O kididi kia dianga ku Xipele — a banza mu jinzo ja kibhanga.

paphos.name: Pafu
paphos.note: O nguzu i londekesa ku ana a tata o Njimbu Iambote.
events: Elima o muloji u bhua mufofo
Selujiu Paulu o mfumu u xikina
Tunde bhabha «Phaulu» u tuala ku pholo

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: O poltu mu Panfília — bhabha Nzuá Marku u vutuka.

pantioch.name: Antiokia ia Pisídia
pantioch.note: O Njimbu Iambote i jikuka ku aJentiu.
events: Musunji ua leba ua musoso ua kubhuluka mu nzo ia kibhanga
AJentiu avulu a sanguluka anga a tambula o Diambu
A a kaie ku kutata

iconium.name: Ikónio
iconium.note: Avulu a xikina, maji o kufikidisa ku a bhingesa kuenda ku pholo.

lystra.name: Listala
lystra.note: A mu ixana kala nzambi, kurima a mu takula matadi.
events: U uikisa muthu ua kilema tunde ku kuvualua
O mundu u sota ku bhana jisata kua ene kala jinzambi
A mu takula matadi anga a mu xisa kala uafu, maji u balumuka

derbe.name: Delbe
derbe.note: A bhanga adisíbulu avulu; a vutuka mu njila phala kukolesa o jingeleja.

troas.name: Toloa
troas.note: O kididi kia kubiluka mudi o Njimbu Iambote i ia dianga ku Eulopa.
events: O kimonekenu kia diiala dia Masedónia
«Zúke kuku, u tu kuatekese»
A bhitila mu Eulopa lukasu

philippi.name: Filipe
philippi.note: O dingeleja dia dianga dia Eulopa — o Njimbu Iambote i xina né mu kaleia.
events: Lídia, o musumbisi ua jinguu ja púlupula, u xikina
O mubhika ua muhatu ua kutela makutu u bhululua
O jinjimbu ku uttu, o kudikina kua ixi, o muiji ua mulangidi ua kaleia ubhuluka

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: O Diambu di dikina o mbanza anga o kutata ku vokiya.
events: U zuela mu nzo ia kibhanga jisábhalu jitatu
«Ana a bhalumuna o ngongo»
A tunda ku usuku

berea.name: Bereia
berea.note: O «aiuka» a tonginina o Diambu ene muene.
events: A tambula o Diambu ni muxima uoso
Izuua ni izuua a tonginina o Madivulu phala ku ki setekesa
Avulu a bhita mu kuxikana

athens.name: Atena
athens.note: Mu mbanza ia jindunge u banza o «Nzambi ka a mu ijiia».
events: U dikexila mukonda dia mbanza iezala ni iteka
Bhu Aleópago u banza o Mubhangi ni o kufukunuka
A mu zomba, maji amoxi a xikina

corinth.name: Kolindo
corinth.note: U xikama muku ua mivu umoxi ni kaxi, u tunga dingeleja mu mbanza ia undumbu.
events: U bhanga jitenda ni Akila ni Priskila
«Ku u kale ni uoma… mukonda ngala ni eie»
AKolindo avulu a xikina anga a batizua

ephesus.name: Efezo
ephesus.note: O muxima ua njila iatatu — o Diambu di suluka mu Ásia ioso.
events: O malongi ma izuua ni izuua mivu iiadi mu nzo ia Tilanu
O madivulu a uanga a jó; o ikalakalu ia nguzu
Demétliu o musongi ua palata u matekena o ngula

miletus.name: Mileto
miletus.note: O kusakela kua masoxi ku jindala ja Efezo.
events: «Langenu o dingeleja ki ua sumba ni manhinga mê muene»
O jindala a dila, a kijiia kuma ki a mu mona dingi

caesarea.name: Kezaléia
caesarea.today: ku mbandu ua kalunga ka Izalaiele lelu
caesarea.note: Mu mivu iiadi u dizuelela o Njimbu Iambote ku pholo ia jimfumu ni sobha.
events: O kufundisa ku pholo ia jimfumu Felísi ni Festu
O kudizuelela kuê ku pholo ia sobha Agilipa
«Ngi bhinga o kufundisa kua Kézali» — ku Loma

jerusalem.name: Jeluzaleme
jerusalem.note: A mu kuata mu tembulu, o njila iê ia ubhika i matekena.
events: A mu kuata kua mundu mu tembulu
U dizuelela ku pholo ia kibuka kia jindala
Kala mukua ixi ua Loma, a mu tumikisa ni masoladi ku Kezaléia

myra.name: Mira
myra.note: A bhituluka ku ngalaua ia Alesandília iaia ku Loma.

fairhaven.name: Jipoltu Jiambote (Kelete)
fairhaven.note: O kudimuna kua Phaulu phala kuxikama ku kuenda ka a mu ivua.

crete.name: Kelete
crete.note: Kurima dia kutunda kaleia, o dixi mudi u xisa Tito phala kuiudika o jingeleja.
events: U xisa Tito phala kubhaka atuameni mu mbanza ioso
U bhinga atuameni ka a mu zuata, a kidielela
U soneka o mukanda kua Tito

malta.name: Malata
malta.note: Ku thandu dia kitembu ni kubhukumuka kua ngalaua, o kikanenu kia Nzambi ki kola.
events: O «kitembu kia norte» ki bhukumuna o ngalaua, maji athu 276 oso a bhuluka
U mu suma o nhoka, maji ka bhuile kima
U bhulula akua kata a dixi

syracuse.name: Sirakuza
syracuse.note: A xikama izuua itatu mu Sisília.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: A bhitila mu Itália anga o jiphange ja a tambula.

rome.name: Loma
rome.book: Jipoxolo 28 · Jimukanda ja Kaleia · II Timote
rome.note: O Njimbu Iambote i bhixila ku muxima ua utuminu ku disukilu — ki disukilu kana, maji dimatekenu.
events: Mivu iiadi mu kudilanga ku nzo, u banza o Utuminu ua Nzambi sé uoma
Tunde bhabha u soneka o Jimukanda ja Kaleia (Efezo·Filipe·Kolose·Filemone)
Kurima a mu kuata dingi, u soneka o II Timote anga a mu jibhila o kuxikana — «Ngalua o kita kiambote, ngazubha o njila»

journeys.j5: Njila ia katanu · ku rima dia kutunda kaleia
